# Nurturing Passion,  Mentoring Success.

Besides providing capital, TCA members act as mentors for the investee companies as well as those venturing into the business world. Our group of Investors, who come from a dynamic range of sectors, are able to handhold the entrepreneur through the life cycle of fundraising and open doors to customers and partners of very high order.

## The Chennai Angels’ (TCA)  Funding process

## Stage 1

## Prescreening & Investor Presentation

A screening committee evaluates the startup's application, followed by a pitch presentation to potential investors.

## Stage 2

## Deep Dive Evaluation​

A detailed meeting where investors scrutinize the startup's business model, financials, and operations.

## Stage 3

## Term Sheet & Due Diligence​

The negotiation of deal terms and company valuation, followed by a comprehensive review of the company's records.

## Stage 4

## Deal Closure

The finalization of the investment agreement and the official closing of the funding round.
